description: This file defines the OrderService interface, which declares methods for managing orders within the e-commerce system, including order processing, total calculation, invoice generation, and status updates.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: OrderService is an interface that declares the core operations related to order management in the system.

methods.name: addOrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Adds a status history record to an order.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total summary for an order based on order details, customer info, store, and language.

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total summary for a shopping cart, considering customer and store details.

methods.name: generateInvoice
methods.description: Generates a PDF invoice for an order.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all orders associated with a given store.

methods.name: listByStore (overloaded)
methods.description: Lists orders filtered by store and criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates an order in the system.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order, including customer details, items, payment, and store context.

methods.name: hasDownloadFiles
methods.description: Checks if an order has associated download files.
